purpose: A bounded change to what is learned from an error: image-conditioned contrastive error notes versus the exact same two supervised raw errors. v7's fixed source-bank construction is closed; no larger training/error search or reuse of report answers.
hypothesis: A model-generated correction rule with observed cues, applicability and exclusion conditions transfers B-training error information better than replaying the original question and corrected answer, while preserving H0-correct A cases.
source: The exact two B-training raw errors selected by frozen v7 corrective_memory, with their original training images and initial response. No new training predictions, no report feedback and no selection of sources from v7 report effects.

selection.B: two-to-four-image comparison, B groups assigned first
selection.rule: Metadata-only selection and member freeze before label association. Exclude all252 prior groups and known shared canonical images/source URLs. All48 are new development reports, with no tuning role.

learning.note_generation: Exactly one local Sol High call per source error, with original training images/question, full semantic mistaken and supervised target options, and first-pass training response. No tools, repair retries, candidate search or report context. Save raw generation before validation.
learning.validation: Exact six nonempty string fields, total at most1800 characters, no explicit answer-output-control directives or option-letter references. Invalid output irreversibly stops this experiment and preserves all planned report denominators. This validates structure, not medical truth.
learning.memory: Two immutable structured error notes, one per source, held in HCL snapshot abstract storage through this explicit extension; not the official consolidate_task routine or full HCL optimizer. Include all six fields at inference. Raw arm uses unchanged v7 global lexical top2 and semantic historical answer rendering. Note arm uses both fixed source notes; two slots in both, no query router or threshold tuning.
learning.limitations: The notes are model-generated, conditioned on training images but not expert-validated. Content, length and note-construction inference cost differ; measure all and do not claim token-matched or clinically grounded knowledge.

execution.order: A/B interleaved cases, rotate three arms by case index, fresh native Agent and MemorySaver per cell; no aliasing
execution.freeze: Freeze source before generation, both complete valid notes and all states before report inference. Report gold opened only after all144 predictions or irreversible termination; failures/notrun remain wrong in full denominators.
execution.unchanged: Author six tools/defaults, system/question prompt, current images/options, original two-turn final A-F exact scoring, subscription model/reasoning. No baseline/tool tuning.

analysis.primary: All three arms A/B and pooled accuracy and all paired four-cell gains/losses, descriptive exact McNemar. B is correction-transfer endpoint; A is preservation of existing baseline ability, not A acquisition or retention of newly learned A.
analysis.development_signal: Both notes structurally valid and all144 report episodes complete/valid; error_notes net gain at least2/24 on B over both H0 and raw_errors; no loss of H0-correct cases in either A or B. No relaxed threshold based on v7's one-case observation.
secondary: note provenance and actual raw/abstract exposure
explicit initial-final option changes with parseable denominator
analysis.decision: One fixed note per error, one fresh report panel, no score-driven note editing or retries. Null closes this fixed image-conditioned abstraction route. Positive signal still requires new frozen sequential learning/retention validation; no clinical or full continual-learning claim.

storage: Read-only reuse all existing assets; count v4/v5/v6/v7/v8 aggregate under45GB stop and strict50GB. Pure-Python storage probes and neutral process argv.
public_boundary: Source/protocol/aggregate only; never publish questions, images, answers, identifiers, notes, per-case predictions or credentials.
